# Wharf 0.13.0 research

## Scope

Session 13 reconstructs unfinished work from retained event streams and
prepares a deterministic resume plan without repeating completed logical
attempts or changing retry counts.

## Decisions

- Replay and validate the append-only event stream before planning resume.
- Treat completed logical attempts and deterministic failures as terminal.
- Resume unfinished attempts and explicitly retryable failures in stable
  attempt-ID order.
- Reconcile live resource IDs and report orphans without silently deleting
  evidence or resources.
- Keep immutable attempt and retry identifiers from the retained events.

## Deferred

Operator stop cleanup, notifications, and report generation remain later
sessions.
